chosen.premise: Eevee's genes are so responsive that even its face can start resembling its Trainer.
chosen.hook: Eevee can become so influenced by you that its face changes.
chosen.visualIdea: Crossfade Eevee's face with a Trainer's face, emphasizing the eyes, ears, and muzzle before returning to Eevee.
chosen.note: The rarest and most startling fact in the set, backed by a specific official Pokédex entry. The visual can be memorable, though it must avoid implying a precise anatomical transformation the source does not describe.

candidates.premise: Eevee is one Pokémon whose evolution chain branches into eight different species.
candidates.hook: Eevee doesn't have one evolution—it has eight.
candidates.visualIdea: Start with Eevee, then branch eight colored paths into Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Espeon, Umbreon, Leafeon, Glaceon, and Sylveon.
candidates.note: A defining Eevee premise with a clean, countable payoff and an instantly readable branching visual. Familiar to many fans, so the surprise is strong but not exceptional.

candidates.premise: Eevee's unstable genes explain its many evolutions, but why only Eevee has them remains unsolved.
candidates.hook: Eevee's greatest mystery is written directly into its genes.
candidates.visualIdea: Zoom into a DNA strand that splits into eight silhouettes, then freeze on a question mark over the unstable genetic code.
candidates.note: A genuinely Eevee-specific mystery: its unstable genes are tied to its evolutions, yet the reason only Eevee has them remains unsolved. The genetic visual is compelling but necessarily somewhat abstract.

candidates.premise: Eevee can evolve through stones, friendship, time, location, a Fairy move, and affection.
candidates.hook: Eevee's evolution depends on far more than just leveling up.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Eevee beside a Water, Thunder, and Fire Stone, then rapidly switch to day, night, friendship, locations, and a Fairy move.
candidates.note: The six distinct evolution triggers make a strong mechanic-driven episode. The methods are cited from trusted secondary data, but some are game-specific and the premise needs careful wording.

candidates.premise: Eevee's Gigantamax form grows from 0.3 meters and 6.5 kilograms to 18 meters and 1,000 kilograms.
candidates.hook: Eevee can go from a small 6.5-kilo Pokémon to a one-ton giant.
candidates.visualIdea: Put regular Eevee beside a height scale, then expand it to 18 meters and overlay a 1,000-kilogram weight counter.
candidates.note: The 0.3-meter, 6.5-kilogram-to-18-meter, 1,000-kilogram jump is concrete and highly visual. It is less uniquely Eevee because the same scale-comparison format can fit other Gigantamax Pokémon.

candidates.premise: Eevee can alter its body to match its surroundings, evolving into different forms as its environment changes.
candidates.hook: Eevee doesn't just live in an environment—it changes to fit it.
candidates.visualIdea: Place Eevee in changing environments while its body silhouette morphs into contrasting evolutionary forms.
candidates.note: Official entries support environmental adaptation, but the idea overlaps with Eevee's broader evolution premise and can overstate how directly every evolution is caused by habitat.
